content.text: ▪︎MC 2/2 atherosclerosis + coronary a. vasospasm; other etiologies: stenosis, pulm HTN, severe systemic HTN, HCM
▪︎= demand for blood/O2 > coronary supply → inadequate perfusion/ischemia → angina
– DAPT for ≥1yr if drug-eluting stent placed
): all pts w/ CAD should be on a β
▪︎chronic CAD tx also incl nitrates & CCBs (antianginal)
▪︎definitive tx = revascularization; PCI favored for 1-2 vessel dz, no left main, preserved LV fxn; CABG favored for left main, complex multivessel dz, + ⇣LV fxn
▪︎DM: PCI acceptable in single-vessel dz; DM + multivessel dz → CABG preferred
